info.title: Ammitto static data API
info.description: Read-only generated files. No API key, server-side search, filtering, pagination, or hosted SPARQL query endpoint. Discover available files in /index.jsonld; publication contents and counts change. JSON-LD suffixes are required. Identifiers may span path segments: use indexes rather than assuming an opaque one-segment id. Error handling and HTTP caching are provided by static hosting.
